messages:
maya: Heads-up — wiring a new A/B flow into Console to run a Homepage hero copy experiment.
maya: Quick Q: should the UI force a single guard type or allow multiple per experiment? @oliver @sam
oliver: allow multiple. ops wants both latency and error guards for prod canaries.
sam: +1, but surface a recommended preset (canary-safe) so PMs don't misconfigure.
jon: UX nit: if someone picks two guards we need clear precedence: fail-if-any vs weighted failure.
maya: propose default = fail-on-any -> rollback. add an "advanced" toggle for custom logic.
sam: can we show estimated traffic impact live in the modal when adjusting weights? e.g., p95 token cost.
maya: yes — we'll compute estimated QPS and token-cost delta client-side using route telemetry profile.
oliver: API question — encode guards as a list of objects or as an expression? leaning towards object list for telemetry hooks.
jon: object list is easier for Dashboard wiring (each guard becomes a chart tile). expression is harder to surface.
devex: +1 object list. also store rollup metric names so alerts map cleanly.
maya: sample config I mocked (pseudo): experiment_id hp_hero_copy_v2; variants: A=80, B=20; guards: latency p95_latency_ms threshold 500ms window 5m; error_rate 5xx_rate threshold 0.01 window 1m; fallback A; start_time 2025-06-20T15:00:00Z
oliver: add notify_on_trip e.g. #eng-oncall,#product and a min_sample_size field.
sam: add ramp_steps too — like 5% -> 20% -> 100% over N minutes.
jon: UX: where do we show historical trial results? inside experiment detail with per-variant breakdown + guard timeline.
maya: yes. Console will surface a condensed timeline: traffic split, guard hits, metric deltas, and a small chart.
devex: include client_region routing rule so initial launch can be NA-only.
maya: final checklist before I implement Console API client: store guards as objects; default fail-on-any; show estimated impact in modal; support ramp_steps + min_sample_size; optional routing_rules (region, header, user_bucket); webhook/notify_on_trip.
oliver: also validate weights sum to 100 and server-side min_sample_size sanity checks.
sam: I'll draft the Console copy for the advanced help tooltip.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch feature/console-abexp on staging — tests running :gear: 
maya: thanks — I'll open the console PR and link it here when done.
jon: I'll open a dashboard ticket to add guard tiles for p95 and 5xx.
sam: :thumbsup: 
maya: thanks team!
